To find the physical dimension of momentum, we use its definition as the product of mass and speed.

1.  **Identify the dimensions of the inputs:**
    - The dimension of mass is $\text{Mass}$.
    - The dimension of speed is length divided by time, which is $\frac{\text{Length}}{\text{Time}}$.

2.  **Calculate the resulting dimension:**
    $$\text{Momentum} = \text{Mass} \times \text{Speed}$$
    $$\text{Dimension(Momentum)} = \text{Mass} \times \left(\frac{\text{Length}}{\text{Time}}\right)$$

3.  **Express as a product/division of base dimensions:**
    The physical dimension is $\text{Mass} * \text{Length} / \text{Time}$.

<ANSWER>Mass * Length / Time</ANSWER>
